areas.name: Early childhood and education
areas.reason: Priority school audience; general and specific objectives, relevant resources, SMART indicators and an education component; moderate impact; innovative non-formal education practice.

areas.name: Secondary/technical education
areas.reason: Same context as basic education, with indicators and resources, but lower impact because the local school network centres on earlier levels.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: Aligned on memory and cultural diversity, but components, robust indicators and resources only partly evidenced; moderate impact.

areas.name: Science, technology and innovation
areas.reason: Aligned objectives, scientific equipment products and significant resources; the related indicator is not relevant to impact; moderate impact; innovative elements.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Weak contribution to service quality and tourism; components, products and indicators fragile; resources unclear; efficiency and innovation not consistently shown.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: No evidence of direct, expressive contribution; no objectives, indicators, targets or resources meeting minimum criteria.

areas.name: Regional equity
areas.reason: Components and indicators address local social inequality, not regional inequality; structure insufficient to measure results.

not_accepted.name: Sustainable cities
not_accepted.reason: No evidence of direct, expressive contribution; no objectives, indicators, targets or resources meeting minimum criteria.

not_accepted.name: Regional equity
not_accepted.reason: Components and indicators address local social inequality, not regional inequality; structure insufficient to measure results.
